records.name: Foraged Supply Drive
records.summary: Gatherers are needed to close a local shortage in herbs, tea, fruit, or other light field goods.

records.name: Hunting For The Pots
records.summary: Local kitchens and storehouses need meat, hides, or bone goods from fresh hunting runs.

records.name: Temporary Farmhands
records.summary: Seasonal labor is needed to stop field losses before they become a larger regional shortage.

records.name: Herbal Remedy Gathering
records.summary: Bath houses, apothecaries, and kitchens need fresh botanicals before the drying lofts run bare.

records.name: Pest Clearance
records.summary: Barns, fields, and storehouses need dangerous vermin or nuisance monsters cleared before supplies spoil.

records.name: Field Boar Drive
records.summary: Crop land on the edge of settlement needs aggressive boars driven down before they ruin another planting or kill livestock.

records.name: Cargo Restacking
records.summary: Warehouses, docks, and yards need temporary hands to move, sort, and secure incoming goods.

records.name: Porter Run
records.summary: Guild yards need reliable backs and pack animals to move goods through short but urgent local routes.

records.name: Lockside Handlers
records.summary: Canal basins and ferry landings need hands to shift cargo between wagons, wharves, and waiting barges.

records.name: Caravan Escort
records.summary: A caravan, barge train, or merchant convoy needs armed protection for a valuable run.

records.name: Mine Shoring Detail
records.summary: A shaft, quarry face, or tunnel line needs temporary crews before a productive seam is lost to bad supports or flooding.

records.name: Mine Beast Clearance
records.summary: Dangerous creatures have nested too close to shafts or quarry ledges and must be culled before production resumes.

records.name: Frontier Survey
records.summary: A guild needs new route, herb, ore, or terrain information from unsettled ground.

records.name: Ruin Recovery Charter
records.summary: A guild wants records, salvage, or reclaimable goods recovered from unstable ruins before weather or raiders strip the site bare.

records.name: Monster Subjugation
records.summary: A hostile monster presence needs to be culled before travel, fields, or storehouses become unsafe.

records.name: Shoreline Salvage
records.summary: A hazardous stretch of coast or riverbank has recoverable cargo, wreckage, or washed-up goods worth claiming.

records.name: Dock Rat Cull
records.summary: Granaries, dockside lofts, and store sheds need local hazards cleared before they ruin another load of cargo.

records.name: Road Watch Muster
records.summary: A road lane or ferry approach has grown dangerous enough that guild traffic needs reinforced guards for a short season.

records.name: Irrigation Ditch Clearing
records.summary: Field channels, sluices, and embankments need hands before standing water and blocked flow ruin another planting.

records.name: Granary Sanitation Detail
records.summary: Storage lofts and granary cellars need cleaning and hazard removal before vermin and ooze ruin the reserve.

records.name: Herd Recovery Drive
records.summary: Drovers need help replacing lost meat, hides, and herd stock before contracts and grazing schedules collapse.

records.name: River Net Repair
records.summary: Fish runs are backing up behind torn netting and broken poles, and the riverside yards need hands immediately.

records.name: Timber Cutting Contract
records.summary: Local wood yards need fast cutting and hauling before mills, kilns, and ship sheds outrun their piles.

records.name: Charcoal Burn Shift
records.summary: A run of charcoal pits and drying stacks needs extra labor before the forge quarter goes hungry for fuel.

records.name: Ore Train Porterage
records.summary: Ore yards and quarry depots need backs, sledges, and beasts to move a pressured run through steep or muddy approaches.

records.name: Smithy Rush Order
records.summary: Forge rows need temporary hammer hands and bellows crews to close a tools-and-arms backlog before clients walk.

records.name: Kiln Firing Watch
records.summary: Kilns, drying sheds, and furnace teams need extra hands to keep a firing cycle from collapsing into waste.

records.name: Textile Finishing Shift
records.summary: A cloth hall is short of hands for washing, fulling, trimming, and packing work before a profitable order slips.

records.name: Gem Lot Security
records.summary: A high-value lot of cut stone, ore, or bullion needs armed escort through exposed roads and jealous checkpoints.

records.name: Kobold Road Ambush
records.summary: A nest of road kobolds has started trapping approaches, stripping packs, and probing the local watch.

records.name: Lock Ooze Purge
records.summary: A lock, canal basin, or ferry approach has turned dangerous with ooze growth and violent water spirits.

records.name: Wolfpack Cull
records.summary: A breeding pair and its pack have started taking stock, travelers, and lone shepherds from the outer lanes.

records.name: Catacomb Sweep
records.summary: A burial complex, undercroft, or ruined vault needs a disciplined clear before records or relics can be reclaimed.

records.name: Quarry Scorpion Hunt
records.summary: Venomous burrowers have infested spoil heaps and quarry faces, making ordinary stone crews unwilling to work.

records.name: Cellar Ooze Clearance
records.summary: Cool cellars and drainage runs have turned slick with ooze growth, and stores must be cleared before another spoilage wave hits.

records.name: Frontier Wreck Recovery
records.summary: Scattered freight, smashed tackle, and recoverable manifests lie on a dangerous route that needs armed salvage crews.
